caption:
Freshers stress for months over which company to join.

A few years later, nobody asks where your first job was. They ask what you can build, debug and own.

A smaller company where you ship every week can teach more than a big brand where you wait months for your first real task.

Pick the place where you'll learn the most. The salary catches up.

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

Your first job won't define your career.

What you learn in your [[first 2 years]] will.
